title: 第七章  灵级斗铠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

-世纪大学

第二天一大早，叶落就被一阵钟声闹醒，“是期初武考，”叶落赶紧爬起来，洗漱完毕，随便往嘴里塞了点东西就跑了出去。期初武考，老师昨天就和他讲了，虽然现在的他仅仅只是炼体九重，但至少也得去长长见识。

“好大的演武场，学校果然有钱的很”

“我们在A区，你快过来”是沈苍月，“老师还是挺关心我的嘛”

过了一会，秦月星也发了相同的话来。

等到叶落赶到A区的时候，整个演武场几乎已经坐满了人，虽说只是一次期初武考，但毕竟是大二的学生，这对于大一学生来说，也是不可多见的。

**台上夜鑫审视着演武台下的一帮学生，开口道，“同学们，今天的这场武考将是对你们假期修炼的一次检验，同时也能让你们的老师们制定更好的修炼计划，其余的废话我就不多说了，下面进行抽签。”

“抽签”，叶落有些疑惑，“沈老师，这抽签是不是有些不公平啊？”

沈苍月微微一笑，“公平，现在公平了，域外战场上会给你公平吗，更何况，这是最省时的办法。”

叶落点了点头，“域外战场，总有一日我也会去的。”

很快，抽签结果就出来了，自然是有人欢喜，有人忧，一共有十个演武台，一般第一，第二轮都是全部开启的，到后期开的越少，毕竟只有到后期才更有意思。

“好，请一至二十号选手入场。”裁判喊道；

话音刚落，便是有20名学生冲上了演武台，没有一丝废话，开始了战斗。

“叶落，你看一下第七号演武台，两人都是聚灵五重，你觉得谁会赢？”

Page (1/3)

- SEGi University

Early the next morning, Ye Luo was woken up by the sound of a bell, "It's the martial arts exam at the beginning of the semester." Ye Luo quickly got up, finished washing, stuffed something into his mouth and ran out.For the martial arts exam at the beginning of the semester, the teacher told him yesterday that although he was only at the ninth level of physical training, he at least had to gain experience.

"It's such a big martial arts arena. The school is really rich."

"We are in Area A, come here quickly." It was Shen Cangyue. "The teacher still cares about me."

After a while, Qin Yuexing also said the same thing.

By the time Ye Luo arrived in Area A, the entire martial arts arena was almost full of people. Although it was just an early martial arts test, he was a sophomore after all, which was rare for a freshman.

**On the stage, Ye Xin looked at the group of students under the martial arts stage and said, "Students, today's martial arts test will be a test of your holiday training. It will also allow your teachers to formulate better training plans. I won't say any more nonsense. Let's draw lots."

"Drawing lots", Ye Luo was a little confused, "Teacher Shen, isn't this drawing of lots unfair?"

Shen Cangyue smiled slightly, "Fair, it's fair now. Will you be fair on the battlefield outside the territory? What's more, this is the most time-saving method."

Ye Luo nodded, "I will go to the battlefield outside the territory one day."

Soon, the results of the lottery came out. Naturally, some people were happy and some were worried. There were ten martial arts stages in total. Generally, all the stages were opened in the first and second rounds. The fewer stages were opened in the later stages. After all, only the later stages were more interesting.

"Okay, please invite players No. 1 to 20 to enter." the referee shouted;

As soon as he finished speaking, 20 students rushed to the martial arts stage and started fighting without any nonsense.

"Ye Luo, take a look at the seventh martial arts stage. Both of them are at the fifth level of gathering spirits. Who do you think will win?"
